resources.string: Save logs to the SD card to send with a bug report

Something went wrong? Save a report and attach it when you tell us about the problem. It holds the system logs from now and from the last start, crash reports and a description of this console. It takes about a minute.
Optional. What were you doing, and what happened?
Describe the problem. It goes into the report.
Saved to EASYROMS, in the folder andr36oid-reports
There is no EASYROMS partition and no internal Download folder to save it to.

The report stopped before it was done.

The last start ended with a system crash. Its log is kept and goes into the report.
Kept, they go into the report.
None. They are only kept when the console restarts, not when it was switched off or the battery ran empty.
The report lists your apps and can contain the names of Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth devices. It doesn\'t contain your games or files. Have a look before you post it in public.
